One side may carry a defect that its mirror counterpart does not have. The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). (A) [0.6688, 0.0863, 0.8488, 0.2663]
(B) [0.0255, 0.6432, 0.2055, 0.8232]
(C) [0.1512, 0.0863, 0.3312, 0.2663]
(D) The two halves match; no defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
